package.name: mgg_core
package.description:
The MGG planner core: grid-based local exploration, the global topological graph, and the multi-robot graph merge.
Deliberately free of ROS. It depends on Eigen and nothing else, so the planning algorithm can be unit tested without a ROS installation, a simulator or a robot, and so the same code can run in ARGoS and on a deployed robot. ROS types are converted at the mgg_ros boundary.
ament_cmake is used to build and install it, but that is a build system choice; the library links no ROS libraries.
